info.name: MyAdvisor - COMP 3613 Assignment 2
info.description: 90 sequential requests covering all three MyAdvisor workflows and all 15 JSON API operations. Student=regular_user; Advisor=admin. Explicit role-specific access_token cookies, disabled cookie jar and redirects. Set collection credentials locally; run in order against a disposable localhost database. Dynamic plan/course/account IDs; explicit missing-prerequisite negative case; four read-back checkpoints for failed writes. Creates one isolation Student and two retained Cancelled plans per successful run. See README.md. Statically reviewed only; Postman/Newman execution pending.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost):\d+$/.test(base)) throw new Error("Use the disposable localhost server URL without a trailing slash");
